description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing dependency picklists in the vtiger CRM system, including AJAX requests for CRUD operations, UI interactions, and data serialization for dependency mappings.

methods.name: changeDependencyPicklistModule
methods.description: Initiates AJAX request to change dependency picklist module and updates UI with response.

methods.name: addNewDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Adds a new dependency picklist for the selected module via AJAX.

methods.name: editNewDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Prepares and sends AJAX request to edit a new dependency picklist based on selected source and target fields.

methods.name: editDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to edit an existing dependency picklist with specified source and target fields.

methods.name: deleteDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a dependency picklist via AJAX.

methods.name: saveDependency
methods.description: Serializes dependency mapping data and saves it via AJAX.

methods.name: serializeData
methods.description: Serializes the current dependency mapping data into JSON format for saving.

methods.name: selectSourceValue
methods.description: Selects a source value checkbox by index.

methods.name: selectTargetValue
methods.description: Highlights a target value cell based on source index and target value.

methods.name: unselectTargetValue
methods.description: Removes highlight from a target value cell.

methods.name: loadMappingForSelectedValues
methods.description: Displays mapping cells for selected source values.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles click event on a cell, toggling selection and tracking modified cells.

methods.name: handleCellMouseDown
methods.description: Tracks mouse down event for cell drag selection.

methods.name: handleCellMouseOver
methods.description: Handles mouse over event for drag selection of cells.

methods.name: handleCellMouseUp
methods.description: Resets mouse down tracking after mouse up event.
